mapper.select: SELECT * FROM script_answer WHERE script_id = #{scriptId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO script_answer (script_id, character_answer, time_answer, location_answer, action_answer, scoring_rule_json) VALUES (#{scriptId}, #{characterAnswer}, #{timeAnswer}, #{locationAnswer}, #{actionAnswer}, #{scoringRuleJson})
mapper.update: UPDATE script_answer SET character_answer = #{characterAnswer}, time_answer = #{timeAnswer}, location_answer = #{locationAnswer}, action_answer = #{actionAnswer}, scoring_rule_json = #{scoringRuleJson} WHERE id = #{id}
